ZGETRANGESIZE.summary: Returns the estimated size in bytes of a key range.
ZGETRANGESIZE.complexity: O(1). The returned size is an estimate, not an exact count.

reply_schema.description: The estimated size of the range in bytes.

arguments.name: begin
arguments.summary: The start of the range. Use * for an unbounded start.

arguments.name: end
arguments.summary: The end of the range. Use * for an unbounded end.
